tools.summary: Read-only compact observability for bounded tool-use audit aggregates.
tools.notes: Operator/coordinator observability surface for compact, redacted tool-use audit aggregates from the workspace_tool_usage_audit MCP route. It observes policy-adherence evidence only: it does not dispatch agents, mutate records, run lint/generate, block or authorize calls, route agents, scrape broad logs, or reinterpret domain tool authority. Misuse-code vocabulary lives in packages/wiki-core/data/tool-use-policy.v1.json under WK-1437; routing-intent ids and replacement-call guidance remain owned by WK-1438 via packages/wiki-core/data/tool-routing-intents.v1.json and the router/discovery docs.
